svg.aria-label: Growth-curve analysis: doubling exponents, extrapolated 32-bit nonce times, and AICc model selection across 7 SAT tracks

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Growth-Curve Fits, 32-Bit Nonce Extrapolation & Sub-Exponential Model Selection
Shifted pure exponential M1: T(k) = c₀ + a·2^(αk) vs. polynomial (M2), √k (M3), and stretched-exp (M4) · 64-round FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 (1C)
A. Fitted Scaling Exponent α (base b = 2^α per bit)
Solid bar: uncensored M1 fit · Hollow diamond: Tobit right-censored MLE (+3 T/Os)
B. Extrapolated Full 32-Bit Nonce Time T(32) [log scale]
Minutes (uncapped AVX2) vs. Days (CDCL) · ~1,400× to ~47,700× wall-clock gap
C. Sub-Exponential Hypothesis Test: ΔAICc = AICc(M1) − AICc(Mⱼ) (Values > +2 Required to Beat Pure Exponential M1)
Every single bar across all 7 tracks and all 3 modulation families (M2 polynomial k^β, M3 √k, M4 stretched-exp) is strictly negative → pure exponential M1 wins 7 / 7
